Retrieves all items in a specified branch by index

**Panel:** Comma → Data · **Nickname:** `Branch #`

## Inputs

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Tree | `T` | Generic | Tree |  | Input tree |
| Branch Index | `i` | Integer | Item |  | Tree branch index |

## Outputs

| Name | Nickname | Type | Access | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| List | `L` | Generic | List | List of items in specified branch |
